outliers.method: Outlier method: within a cohort of 4 or more values, a value is flagged when its modified z-score (0.6745 * (x - median) / MAD, Iglewicz-Hoaglin) exceeds 3.5 in magnitude OR it lies outside the Tukey fences (Q1 - 1.5 IQR, Q3 + 1.5 IQR). Median/MAD/IQR are used because the cohort itself may contain the outlier. A flag means "look at this", not "this is wrong".
